title: AICP sorted subject tree leaf
description: One leaf of the sorted subject tree committed in an STH (§6.4.6). Leaves are sorted by sub as raw UTF-8 bytes, with no Unicode normalization, and hashed with RFC 9162. The wire names subject_map_root and subject_map_size name this tree.

index_entry.description: Log index of the subject_index entry this leaf commits.

latest_entry.description: Log index of the newest attestation, revocation, or correction in the history.
